# Query-image TV blindness floor, multi-query separation, and three-regime error contrast

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`observational-fidelity-and-multi-regime-error` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](observational-fidelity-and-multi-regime-error.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Over Mathlib ℝ (standard axioms only), ObservationalFidelity proves the exact query TV blindness floor, empty-source infeasibility, coarsening and macro-refinement monotonicity, zero-TV coexistence with FiberViabilitySplit, three-way query separation, and three-regime error contrast.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Finite pushforward obeys total-variation data processing (tvDist_pushforward_le); for any chi : U -> V, query q : V -> O, and mu : FinDist V, every local distribution nu obeys massOutside (q o chi) (pushforward q mu) <= tvDist (pushforward (q o chi) nu) (pushforward q mu), with equality constructively attained when Nonempty U while IsEmpty U renders FinDist U empty (optimal_query_tv_floor, empty_source_infeasible). (`ObservationalFidelity.FinDist`, `ObservationalFidelity.pushforward`, `ObservationalFidelity.tvDist`, `ObservationalFidelity.tvDist_pushforward_le`, `ObservationalFidelity.massOutside`, `ObservationalFidelity.optimal_query_tv_floor`, `ObservationalFidelity.empty_source_infeasible`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
2. Post-composing observations with a coarsening map or factoring maps through a finer macro partition weakly lowers massOutside (coarsening_tv_mono, macro_refinement_tv_mono), while zero observable query TV on dirac distributions coexists with total FiberViabilitySplit and macro-kernel refutation on Becoming.OplaxHistory.C2CoupledAlignmentWitness. (`ObservationalFidelity.coarsening_tv_mono`, `ObservationalFidelity.macro_refinement_tv_mono`, `ObservationalFidelity.zero_tv_does_not_prevent_fiber_viability_split`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
3. On diagonal Bool x Bool supports, individual per-query zero TV does not imply simultaneous marginal feasibility (per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal, sum gap >= 3/5), and simultaneous zero-TV marginals over uniform Bool x Bool fail joint TV realizability (joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist, tvDist >= 1/2). (`ObservationalFidelity.diagSupport`, `ObservationalFidelity.per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal`, `ObservationalFidelity.joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
4. Open-loop Markov kernels accumulate per-step TV error linearly (sequential_kernel_tv_bound) and subadditively across independent tensor sites (independent_tensor_tv_bound), unified in three_regime_error_contrast with contractive feedback tubes (Becoming.AlignmentReals.metricSlack, Becoming.Reals.iterVar_eq_metricSlack) and coupled C2/concurrent reserve breakdown (C2CoupledAlignmentWitness, ConcurrentSerialWitness). (`ObservationalFidelity.FinKernel`, `ObservationalFidelity.pushKernel_tv_step`, `ObservationalFidelity.sequential_kernel_tv_bound`, `ObservationalFidelity.tvDist_prodDist_le`, `ObservationalFidelity.independent_tensor_tv_bound`, `ObservationalFidelity.three_regime_error_contrast`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) through the Mathlib periphery workspace (#13); requires finite Fintype state/query spaces, Nonempty U for optimal TV attainment, time-homogeneous Markov steps, and contractive alpha in [0, 1) for regime-2 feedback tubes.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Finite probability distribution TV bounds and discrete counterexamples never verify that empirical neural policy rollouts or real sensor pipelines are time-homogeneous, independent across sites, or contractive (Rule 2).
- Does not prove finite-sample empirical convergence rates, continuous measurable-space Radon-Nikodym bounds, or continuous-time SDEs.
- **Counterexample:** empty_source_infeasible (IsEmpty U), zero_tv_does_not_prevent_fiber_viability_split (zero TV on C2CoupledAlignmentWitness with total Viability.Kernel failure), per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal (3/5 gap), joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist (1/2 gap), and three_regime_error_contrast part 3 (3-step ConcurrentSerialWitness depletion vs. serialized recovery).
